hero.h1: Sewer Line Cleaning and Rodding in Hanover Park, IL
hero.sub: When the basement floor drain backs up or all the drains slow down at once, the main line is clogged. We rod it clear, show you the cause on camera and price it before we start. Our office is on Greenbrook Boulevard.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber feeding the cable from a drum rodding machine into an outdoor sewer cleanout in a front yard

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: Sewer rodding clears a blocked main line with a long, flexible steel cable fed through a cleanout access point. A cutting head on the end breaks through roots, grease, and debris and pushes the blockage toward the street connection, restoring flow through the pipe. It's the standard first fix for a clogged or backed-up sewer line. For most homes, it's the only fix needed.

img.alt: Diagram showing a rodding cable fed through a cleanout access point into the main sewer line, with a cutting head clearing the blockage toward the street connection

blocks.h2: When Rodding Is Enough, and When It Isn't
blocks.body: Rodding is the right first step for most Hanover Park backups. It's quick and opens the line so the house can drain again. The camera pass afterward is what tells you whether to stop there. If the pipe looks sound and the clog was paper or a small root, you're done. If roots fill a joint, a low spot holds water or a section is cracked, the clog will come back. That's when we talk about jetting, a maintenance schedule or a repair.

blocks.h2: Sewer Cleaning Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: How often should my sewer line be cleaned?
items.preview: Yearly if roots are a problem.
items.answer: If roots have blocked it before, once a year. Otherwise, only when needed.

items.q: Why does my main line keep clogging?
items.preview: Roots, a low spot or a break.
items.answer: Usually roots, a settled low spot or a cracked section. A camera shows which.

items.q: Do I need a camera inspection after rodding?
items.answer: We recommend it. It tells you whether the line just needed cleaning or needs a repair.

items.q: Is rodding the same as hydro jetting?
items.answer: No. Rodding cuts a path through the clog. Jetting scours the whole pipe wall.

items.q: Can I rent a drain snake for my main line?
items.answer: You can, but rental machines can get stuck or damage older pipe, and you won't see what caused the clog. A camera pass is the part most people skip.

items.preview: Often in the basement or near the foundation outside.
items.answer: In most Hanover Park homes, it's a capped pipe in the basement floor or near the foundation outside. We'll find it if you can't.

items.q: How much does sewer line cleaning cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on access and the clog. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on access, the length of the line and the blockage. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
